newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico spot 48-hour peso weakens on speculation.
newsitem.headline: Mexico spot 48-hour peso weakens on speculation.

text.p: Mexico's spot 48-hour peso weakened sharply in mid-day trade, easing through resistance of 7.60 pesos per dollar on speculation, dealers said.
The spot peso was down 5.45 centavos to 7.595/7.6025 per dollar.
Local and foreign investors were seen dumping the peso after primary interest rates fell again at the Cetes auction on Tuesday, dealers said.
"People are saying that a foreign bank covered a large position... and local banks followed, speculating after the market moved," said one dealer.
The 24-hour peso was down 5.4 centavos to 7.59/7.60.
